preconditions.description: Number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices.
The graph is a tree with n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 0 <= d_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= x_i <= 10**9 for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries)

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, int) for value in result)
postconditions.description: Each value in the result is an integer.
The result contains exactly n values, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == sum(x_i for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries if d(v_i, i) <= d_i)
postconditions.description: The value at each vertex is the sum of x_i for all queries where the distance from v_i to the vertex is less than or equal to d_i.
